frequency_question: How often is a major executive branch nomination confirmed by the Senate within 60 days?
membership_rule: Includes all formal nominations to cabinet or major statutory agency head positions (such as FDA Commissioner) where a Senate vote occurred or was pending within a 60-day window from initial submission during modern administrations. Excludes withdrawn nominations prior to committee action.
coverage_note: 10 named; complete set of recent FDA commissioner confirmations spanning multiple administrations.
known_gaps: Varying degrees of Senate control and political contention per case.
skeleton: 10 historical FDA Commissioner nominations evaluated for confirmation within the 60-day window
validity_reason: General Senate confirmation procedures and institutional timelines for agency heads remain stable across presidential terms.
